title: About Legency Media | The Webflow Enterprise Partner for B2B Marketing Teams
description: Legency Media runs Webflow builds, search and AI visibility, and conversion as one accountable system for B2B marketing teams, reported monthly in evidence you can take upward. Enterprise due diligence passed, MSA and SOW paper, PO billing.
mainHtml:
About

Your Webflow
Partner

Legency Media is a Webflow Enterprise partner based in Galway, Ireland, working with B2B teams across the US, UK and EU. We build and maintain websites, improve search and AI visibility, and report on enquiries and conversions each month.

See our client work
The System

Build, search and AI visibility, and conversion run to a single monthly plan, with one team accountable for all of it. Requests go into a shared channel and come back as shipped work, so a pricing change is live before the sales call and a campaign page ships inside its window.

  • Webflow Enterprise Partner

    The official Enterprise tier of the Webflow partner program, and a credential your procurement team can verify in Webflow's own partner directory before the first call.

  • Enterprise due diligence, passed

    A 36-question cyber due diligence questionnaire from a client security team, answered and accepted. Your reviewers get answers on the first pass, so the relationship clears security without a second round.

  • Procurement-ready paper

    MSA and SOW ready to sign, client paper reviewed and signed too, and invoices carrying a purchase order into corporate accounts payable. Legal and finance get what they need the first time.

A Team of Specialists,
Run as One System

What Changes When the Site
Has One Accountable Owner

01

Launches ship on marketing's calendar

A pricing change before the sales call, a campaign page inside its window. Requests go into a shared channel and come back live inside an agreed turnaround, so the site keeps up with what the company sells.

02

You talk to the people who build

The person answering your request is the person doing the work, in your Slack, with last month's context still in their head. Nothing is re-explained and nothing is lost in a handoff.

03

Your team adds pages without a developer

Every site is built as a component system your marketing team can operate: locked templates, pages assembled from parts, nothing that breaks when someone touches it. A new landing page is an afternoon's work, and the rebuild in year two stays off the table.

The Three Pillars

What Every Retainer
Is Built to Deliver

Found by people and by AI

Search and answer engines run as one discipline, with citations across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude counted every month. ChannelSight is now the most-cited domain in its own AI answer set, ahead of three rivals combined.

Evidence you can take upward

One report a month, in the same shape every time: what shipped, what it produced, what happens next. Clients forward it to their CEO, their board and their group parent as it is, which is how the spend defends itself.

Builds that survive year two

Component systems your marketing team can operate without breaking anything, kept sound through rebrands, migrations and scale. Blueflame AI has shipped on the same build through a funding round, an acquisition and a rebrand.

Evidence

Every Number on This Site
Has a Source Behind It

On Blueflame AI, monthly reporting showed organic search overtake paid as the top source of demo requests: 39 people against 19 in a 28-day window.

Google Analytics, on Blueflame’s own demo form, 15 June to 12 July 2026.
